limits: Supply is eth_call totalSupply() and decimals() on https://mainnet.base.org. totalSupplyRaw is the integer. totalSupply is raw / 10^decimals. A missing decimals() leaves the adjusted supply null.

Holders are GeckoTerminal token-info holders.count (network base), the same integer this desk already shows on the asset page. Calls are one at a time, at least 6.5 seconds apart, because a faster pace receives HTTP 429 on this host. HTTP 429 is retried and is not stored as a count. Blockscout's public API for this chain returned a Cloudflare challenge from the snapshot host, and Routescan tokenholdercount does not index chain 8453 (response: chain not supported). A 404 or a payload with no holders.count stays null. The chain total sums per-token counts and is not unique wallets.
supplyUsd is decimal-adjusted total supply times the desk DexScreener price already on the asset. A missing price or supply leaves supplyUsd null. It is not volume.
